notes: User-confirmed mechanics are separate from provisional tuning. No engine kit is registered by this file.

confirmed.P: On gaining Stealth, empower the next attack, allow pouncing onto any enemy and a position swap. Pouncing onto the opposite enemy deals a smaller bonus.
confirmed.Q: Empower the next attack. User accepted this direction; numerical values remain proposed.
confirmed.E: Gain Stealth and a large AD increase; moved from the previous R proposal. Quick classification follows this defensive skill, pending review.
confirmed.R: Choose any enemy champion in any lane. Bola deals damage and applies Hunt; on hit grant one free Q and one free E. Hunt adds substantial true damage as absolute current HP values of Rengar and target become closer.

interpretationsPendingReview: Pounce moves Rengar to his own-side slot in the target enemy lane, swapping with an allied occupant; it does not swap teams with the enemy.
Pounce requires a normal attack action/card. The passive creates no extra attack.
Reapplying an already active Stealth state does not repeatedly arm the passive.
New E retains the former defensive Quick classification; final R Quick classification and exact chain activation conditions are not confirmed.
Free Q/E are proposed as temporary zero-mana cards; their lifetime is not yet confirmed.
Hunt mark duration, trigger count and damage-resolution timing still require review.

rengar.huntFormulaProposal: r3 * max(0, 1 - abs(Rengar_current_HP - target_current_HP) / r4). Equal absolute current HP maximizes true damage. Trigger timing, mark duration, number of triggers and true-damage cap require review.
confirmedCombo: Attack: pounce using normal attack action

confirmed.P: Stealthed allies gain AD and Critical Strike Chance scaling with Ivern HP. No Attack Speed bonus.
confirmed.Q: Quick. Grant an ally a Shield and a guaranteed Critical Strike on their next attack. Shield explosion damage scales with recipient AD.
confirmed.E: Quick. Plant Brush on a slot until the end of the opponent's turn.
confirmed.R: Summon Daisy; attacks may Stun. Ivern and Stealthed allies trigger one Daisy follow-up when they attack.

paramMeaning.p0: AD gained per point of Ivern maximum HP; no passive mana cost
paramMeaning.p1: Critical Strike percentage points per point of Ivern maximum HP
paramMeaning.q2: Shield ratio of Ivern maximum HP
paramMeaning.q4: Explosion ratio of the Shield recipient's AD
paramMeaning.r2: Daisy attack ratio of Ivern maximum HP
paramMeaning.r3: Daisy Stun probability per eligible hit
paramMeaning.r4: Maximum Daisy follow-up hits per triggering attack action

interpretationsPendingReview: HP scaling uses Ivern maximum HP, and the passive only operates while Ivern is alive on the board.
Shield explosion timing and enemy target area are not yet finalized.
Recipient AD is read at explosion resolution; the damage type still requires review.
Brush grants Stealth through a separately specified rule; entering/leaving, revelation, repeat application and empty-slot behavior are not finalized.
Daisy does not trigger further Daisy follow-ups from her own hits or effect damage.
Qualifying Stealth is checked before the triggering attack breaks Stealth.
Both Q/E are confirmed Quick; exact response conditions must be specified before engine implementation.
